vocab.gloss: easy; straightforward; likely; liable to; apt to

example.hanzi: 這個問題很容易，你一定會。
example.pinyin: zhège wèntí hěn róngyì, nǐ yídìng huì.
example.gloss: This question is easy; you'll definitely be able to do it.

example.hanzi: 老師說的話，我都明白了。
example.pinyin: lǎoshī shuō de huà, wǒ dōu míngbái le.
example.gloss: I understand everything the teacher said.

example.hanzi: 根據天氣報告，明天會下雨。
example.pinyin: gēnjù tiānqì bàogào, míngtiān huì xià yǔ.
example.gloss: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.

example.pinyin: nà liàng chē shì wǒ gē de.
example.gloss: That car is my older brother's.

example.hanzi: 這個菜很簡單，我也會做。
example.pinyin: zhège cài hěn jiǎndān, wǒ yě huì zuò.
example.gloss: This dish is very simple; I can make it too.

grammar.title: 根據……，…… (according to / based on)
grammar.pattern: 根據 + 信息來源 + ，+ 句子
grammar.explanation: 「根據」放在句子前面，說明你的話是從哪裡來的，後面常常加上報告、老師說的、網路上的訊息等。說完以後加逗號，再說結果。意思跟英文的 according to 一樣，語氣比較正式一點，但日常生活也很常用。

examples.hanzi: 根據報告，這個月的雨水比較多。
examples.pinyin: gēnjù bàogào, zhège yuè de yǔshuǐ bǐjiào duō.
examples.gloss: According to the report, there is more rain this month.

examples.hanzi: 根據老闆說的，明天我們不用上班。
examples.pinyin: gēnjù lǎobǎn shuō de, míngtiān wǒmen búyòng shàngbān.
examples.gloss: According to what the boss said, we don't have to work tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 根據網路上的訊息，那家店的麵很好吃。
examples.pinyin: gēnjù wǎnglù shàng de xùnxí, nà jiā diàn de miàn hěn hǎochī.
examples.gloss: According to the information online, that shop's noodles are delicious.

dialogue.hanzi: 老闆，這輛腳踏車多少錢？
dialogue.pinyin: lǎobǎn, zhè liàng jiǎotàchē duōshao qián?
dialogue.gloss: Boss, how much is this bike?

dialogue.speaker: 老闆
dialogue.hanzi: 三千五百塊，這輛很容易騎。
dialogue.pinyin: sān qiān wǔ bǎi kuài, zhè liàng hěn róngyì qí.
dialogue.gloss: NT$3,500. This one is very easy to ride.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 可是網路上說七千，我有點不明白。
dialogue.pinyin: kěshì wǎnglù shàng shuō qī qiān, wǒ yǒudiǎn bù míngbái.
dialogue.gloss: But online it says NT$7,000; I'm a bit confused.

dialogue.speaker: 老闆
dialogue.hanzi: 根據網路上的訊息，那輛比較大，我這輛比較小。
dialogue.pinyin: gēnjù wǎnglù shàng de xùnxí, nà liàng bǐjiào dà, wǒ zhè liàng bǐjiào xiǎo.
dialogue.gloss: According to the info online, that one is bigger; mine here is smaller.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 我明白了，很簡單，那我就買這輛。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ míngbái le, hěn jiǎndān, nà wǒ jiù mǎi zhè liàng.
dialogue.gloss: I get it now, it's simple. Then I'll buy this one.

dialogue.speaker: 小明

example.gloss: I didn't see the words on that piece of paper clearly.

grammar.title: 願意 + Verb Phrase (be willing to do something)
grammar.explanation: 願意 means "to be willing to" or "to want to". It goes before the verb phrase and shows that the subject agrees to do something from the heart. To say the opposite, put 不 in front: 不願意. 願意 can also take 嗎 at the end to ask a polite question.

examples.hanzi: 我願意幫你包這些東西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yuànyì bāng nǐ bāo zhèxiē dōngxi.
examples.gloss: I'm willing to help you wrap these things.

examples.hanzi: 他不願意上樓，他說他太累了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú yuànyì shàng lóu, tā shuō tā tài lèi le.
examples.gloss: He doesn't want to go upstairs; he says he's too tired.

examples.hanzi: 你願意跟我一起去上音樂課嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yuànyì gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù shàng yīnyuè kè ma?
examples.gloss: Are you willing to go to the music class with me?

dialogue.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, yīnyuè kè de jiàoshì zài jǐ lóu?
dialogue.gloss: Excuse me, which floor is the music class classroom on?

dialogue.gloss: On the third floor; it starts at seven thirty.

dialogue.hanzi: 謝謝。那這個可以幫我包一下嗎？

dialogue.gloss: Thank you. Then could you wrap this up for me?

dialogue.hanzi: 可以啊，我很願意。你要送人嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ a, wǒ hěn yuànyì. Nǐ yào sòng rén ma?
dialogue.gloss: Sure, I'd be glad to. Is it a gift for someone?

dialogue.speaker: 美美
dialogue.gloss: Yes, it's for my little sister.

grammar.title: 用「覺得」說看法
grammar.pattern: A + 覺得 + 話題 + 很 + 形容詞
grammar.explanation: 「覺得」means "to think / to feel" and is used to give a personal opinion. Put the topic after 覺得, then a description, usually with 很. To ask someone's opinion, use 你覺得……怎麼樣？

examples.hanzi: 我覺得這個故事很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhège gùshì hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.gloss: I think this story is very interesting.

examples.hanzi: 你覺得這張照片怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhè zhāng zhàopiàn zěnmeyàng?
examples.gloss: What do you think of this photo?

examples.hanzi: 他覺得這個新聞很重要。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde zhège xīnwén hěn zhòngyào.
examples.gloss: He thinks this piece of news is very important.
